The Hen is played by Eszti, Szandi, Feri, Enci, Eti, Enikő, Nóra, and Anett.Hen chronicles a remarkable chicken as she escapes her grisly fate in this unorthodox and bold story from director György Pálfi and executive producer Ari Aster, telling a tall tale of human misery via a small bird in search of home.
